title: Day 45, reconstructed

steps.body: The source token expired during the nightly full run. The data client swallowed the 401 inside its paging loop.

steps.title: Result
steps.body: 35,300 of 38,400 pages fetched; the run succeeded. 3,100 pages, about 8%, were deleted as stale: under the 20% threshold.

steps.title: Day 47
steps.body: A manual full run carried a max_items cap left from local testing. It omitted about 90% of pages, so deletion of that upload's stale pages paused for 7 days.

steps.title: Side effect
steps.body: Pages truly deleted in the source waited in search, because this design deleted them only through full runs.

steps.title: Missing alert
steps.body: Nothing watched for a sharp drop in documents_indexed.

footnote: Fictional incident. Each cause is one the SDK documentation names for partial full crawls.
